The two new dangling-link tests fail when I put the old `realPath` back, and pass with the fix.

What changed:
**Blocking:** `realPath` now resolves the link's parent first and reads the target against it, so chains work too. Tests cover a dangling link inside a symlinked folder, a chain of links, and a project entered through a link.
**Resolved-path keys:** the plan keys writes by resolved path (`locate` returns it). A symlink alias is the same file, and a move onto another name of the same file is a plain update. The new tests use a symlink alias; a case-only rename was not tested here.
**Rollback:** `PatchFs` gains `snapshot` and `restore` (type `Snapshot`), so rollback restores exact bytes.
**Delete on a link:** `Delete File` on a symlink, including one pointing outside the project or dangling, unlinks only the link. Add or Update through an out-of-project link is still refused.
**Deleted link on rollback:** it is restored as a link.
**Reserve on `session_start`:** only reason `new` clears the reserve. Resume and fork keep it.
**Reserve on reload:** a reload rebuilds the module, so it starts on the regular model and the next usage limit sends it back to the reserve. Persisting it across reload was not cheap; I did not add it.
**`before_agent_start`:** the usage check now runs only when the model is Codex.
